mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_logs ( member_id, endpoint, http_method, status_code, response_time_ms, ip_address, user_agent, request_body ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{endpoint}, #{httpMethod}, #{statusCode}, #{responseTimeMs}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{requestBody} );
mapper.select: select a.id as a_id, m.id as m_id, m.name as m_name, m.email as m_email, m.role as m_role, a.endpoint as a_endpoint, a.http_method as a_http_method, a.status_code as a_status_code, a.response_time_ms as a_response_time_ms, a.ip_address as a_ip_address, a.user_agent as a_user_agent, a.request_body as a_request_body, a.created_at as a_created_at from api_logs a join members m on a.member_id = m.id where a.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY a.created_at DESC;
